Carbon AI - 2026 Corporate Sustainability & Decarbonization Policy

1. Renewable Energy Target:
   All manufacturing facilities must achieve at least 65% renewable electricity usage by Q4 2027.
   Solar PPA (Power Purchase Agreements) are prioritized for high-energy plants.

2. Supply Chain & Logistics Rules:
   Road transport distances above 400 km should be shifted to rail or electric freight where feasible.
   Suppliers with carbon intensity above 0.85 tCO2e per unit require quarterly audits.

3. Raw Material Efficiency:
   Recycled raw material share must increase by 20% across

audits.

3. Raw Material Efficiency:
   Recycled raw material share must increase by 20% across Steel, Cement, and Packaging units.
   Internal carbon price is set at $75 per tCO2e for capital expenditure planning.
